findings.text: `_partition_runner` reads `arm_excluded_paths(config)` with `config` defaulting to None, but only `measure_run` (queue_landing.py:1310) passes a config. Its other two partitioned callers, reckon/crew/review_landing.py:98 and reckon/crew/standing_suite.py:232, construct the runner with no `config=`, so `arm_excluded_paths(None)` returns () and a project's declared `landing.arm_excluded_paths` is silently ignored on those partitioned arms. Those arms still unpack the whole revision into the node's local disk, so the disk-filling this section prevents can still happen on a review-landing or standing-suite arm. Repairing it means editing review_landing.py/standing_suite.py, which are outside this node's declared write paths; recorded for the coordinator to fold.

call_sites: reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:1310 (measure_run on the landing gate path, config passed)
reckon/crew/review_landing.py:98 (_partition_runner, no config -> exclusion not applied)
reckon/crew/standing_suite.py:232 (_partition_runner, no config -> exclusion not applied)
reviewer_notes.durability_independence: No added assertion compares the code's output against a value the test itself supplied as the expected answer: the archive assertion checks a literal `:(exclude)docs/figures` pathspec the code composes, and the setup assertion checks a refusal string the code composes from a synthetic log.
reviewer_notes.durability_reading: tests/test_a_partitioned_arm_unpacks_what_it_needs.py:140-163 and :199-215 unpack the real submitted archive line and assert the excluded tree lacks docs/figures while carrying the test; :166-197 feeds a header-only setup log and asserts the refusal quotes the node and 'No space left on device' and does not say 'did not run'. Reinstating the base behaviour reddens case 2 with 'the base arm did not run' (gate-base.log:90) and case 1 on the undeclared flight key, so the assertions bind to behaviour, not to values the test handed in.
reviewer_notes.reuse_reading: Searched reckon/ by capability for an existing arm archive/ exclusion owner: checkout_trust.py:536 only resolves a revision's subtree to archive and crew/routing.py:611 mentions plain `git archive` extractions; neither builds an arm's unpack step or owns an exclusion path list, so _archive_step extends the existing inline step in the module that already runs the partition and arm_excluded_paths is the first owner of the declaration.
